title: 9 Pitch Drops Took 84 Years To Fall
hook: The pitch experiment produced only 9 drops in 84 years.
closing: Slow experiments matter because patience can reveal what a quick test never could.
question: Could you watch that long?

segments.say: The pitch experiment produced just 9 drops, making the wait itself part of the result.
Dublin waited 69 years for a pitch drop, proving this liquid moves on a human-lifetime clock.
Pitch is 230 billion times more viscous than water, explaining why a liquid looks completely solid.
